name: design-systems
author: c-wenlong
description: The private designs repo as a browsable library: the gallery of every captured design system (tokens, screenshots, components) plus the docs site and scorecard. nginx serves the Zensical build on 127.0.0.1:8108 behind Serve, and answers /systems/, /tools/, /example/, /catalog.json and /README.md straight from a read-only mount of the working clone at ~/dev/design-systems (same allowlist as the repo's make serve — the ~300 MB of LFS screenshots are never copied into a release). No passphrase: the repo's own Pages deploy strips and encrypts the gallery, but the tailnet is the boundary here. deployd rebuilds when the clone's HEAD moves; ~/services/design-systems/bin/deploy.sh --force rebuilds now.
